// diagnostic

E-TYPE-PREFIX

`?T` and `!E` are retired prefix type marks.

What

`?T` and `!E` are retired prefix type marks.

Why

A type mark follows the type it marks: `Entry?` may be absent, and `SaveError!` in a function contract names how the call fails.

Fix

Write `Entry?` for `?Entry`, `SaveError!` for `!SaveError`, and `(A | B)!` for `!(A | B)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-TYPE-PREFIX: tests/ui/type_mark_prefix_optional_retired.stderr.
